Z score= 1.64 < 1.645 so not statistically signifigant

SEdiff= (standard error difference)
Why 1.645 in SE? It represents 90? Confidence interval so its a magic #

Sampling noise= when a small sample size fails to represent the true underlying distribution

Can get more data
